description: BGSNL membership card design and behavior specification. The approved digital card is connected to account data. Native Apple and Google passes use platform-managed layouts and link to the digital card through a unique QR code. Production deployment and device installation verification are pending.

testSetup.note: Signing credentials belong in ignored local storage, never in this public specification. Native JSON drafts are not native visual previews.

editingNotes: All example member data is mocked. Never use the example QR as a real member link.
Coordinates are approximate measurements from the example, in pixels on the reference canvas. Name and membership label font families and sizes are owner-confirmed.
Null values indicate decisions or assets still to be confirmed.
This file is in public assets. Do not add private member data, credentials, signing keys or live access tokens.

League Spartan.note: Use the valid TrueType font. The existing .woff2 file is misnamed PostScript data, not a web font.

referenceCanvas.note: Design reference dimensions, not the required dimensions of a native Apple or Google Wallet pass.

typography.fontFamilyNote: Use the existing local fonts. Name increased from 46px to 60px and membership label from 34px to 44px for the larger-type preview. League Spartan weight remains to be confirmed.

qrCode.note: Reserve additional space for the quiet zone; validate scan reliability rather than copying the example barcode pixels.

responsiveBehavior.longNames: Allow wrapping and adjust spacing to prevent overlap; do not silently truncate the full name.
responsiveBehavior.missingProfileImage: Show a neutral avatar or initials.
responsiveBehavior.note: These are proposed web-preview behaviors. Native Wallet layouts require separate adaptations.

memberFields.note: Logical fields only; actual database field mappings remain to be implemented.

previewData.profileImageSource: Use a mock image for previews; the example illustration is not a real member profile.

qrCode.tokenDesign: Proposed: opaque, random, unguessable and revocable token; never use an authentication token or sequential account ID.

accountInfoPage.content: Fetch and display the member's current digital card and status from the backend.

statusBadge.lockedBehavior: Display the digital card with a Locked badge; locked is not the same as a revoked or invalid public link.
statusBadge.fetchFailureBehavior: Show status unavailable; never assume active when fetching fails.

proposedSafeguards.revokedOrInvalidToken: Show a generic unavailable message without member information.
proposedSafeguards.privacyNote: Anyone receiving or sharing the link can see the listed fields. Confirm member consent and the public-field policy before launch.

apple.designApproach: Adapt the reference branding and member fields to a supported native pass layout.
apple.assetDimensions: Confirm after choosing the pass style.

google.designApproach: Adapt the reference branding and member fields to the native pass template.
google.assetDimensions: Confirm against current platform specifications when preparing the native preview.

approval.note: Show previews to the owner before uploading final card assets, publishing or issuing live cards. Editing this document does not itself authorize publication.

openDecisions: Status badge placement and styling in the public digital-card preview.
Backend rules that determine active versus locked status.
Native Apple pass style and platform-specific layouts.
Production QR destination and public profile route.
Consent, revocation and public-profile visibility policy.
